opening.argument: The recording documents a purported Windows-support call as an example of how members of the public could be approached, beginning with the caller's claim that "you are speaking to James and I'm calling you from the windows technical department." The caller then directs the listener toward remote access, including "Just click on that, View PC Download Run," while the frame shows a remote-support page and a Windows Run dialog involving administrative privileges. The exchange also contains a payment demand: "Just pay me. Pay me money. I'll fix your computer any time you want." These are the caller's claims and instructions, recorded for examination rather than promotion. The documentation further states, "Obviously I didn't let him in my PC," and does not show payment or computer access.
